Riley P. Bechtel was the Chief operating officer of Bechtel Group, as of March 1989 and became the president and chief executive officer in June 1990. Remember: Denver International Airport started construction in 1989.

Riley P. Bechtel has ties to Stanford University, The Trilateral Commission (Link 1), J.P. Morgan Chase & Co., and more. He's tied to the Bush Administration by George W. Bechtel Corporation - Domestic Info

Bechtel is the largest construction company in the U.S. and the 8th largest privately-owned American company as of 2017 all the while being notorious for running over budget on its projects. It was originally headquartered in San Francisco with the global headquarters in Reston, Virginia. Major domestic areas of operation: Reston, Virginia, San Francisco, Houston, Washington D.C.

To see other locations go to Bizapedia and search under Company: Bechtel + City: Reston + State: Virginia. It will provide a list.

It also has its own political Political Action Committee and has contributed to several Democrats & Republicans in Congress.

Domestically, it has been tied to an expansive number of U.S. infrastructure projects in the areas of transportation, power and telecommunications – road, bridges, dams (Hoover dam), subways, rail, and airports - even NASA’s Space Launch Complex 40. It’s also tied into areas of energy, national security, and even environment: mines, pipelines, oil, natural gas, nuclear power (involved in 80% of U.S. nuclear power plants), solar, and even Google Fiber.

Bechtel leads or is a member of a consortium that manages two national laboratories and a number of national security-related facilities in the U.S., including:

  1. Los Alamos National Laboratory

  2. Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

  3. Y-12 National Security Complex - more info here

  4. Pantex Plant

Bechtel - Overseas Info

Major areas of operation outside the U.S.:

Brisbane, Calgary, Dubai, London, New Delhi, Santiago, Shanghai, Nairobi, Taipai.

Bechtel also has ties to Alwaleed bin Talal – Bechtel built Alwaleed’s Kingdom Tower in the Kingdom Centre in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia which was finished in 2002.

More recently, Bechtel has been working on 39 miles of tunnels 14 stories below ground under Riyadh for a metro system that was supposed to be completed last October. They have numerous underground tunneling projects that they have worked on in the past. Maybe even DIA?
